# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

The Shopify AI Forecast & Inventory Intelligence Bridge project takes security and data privacy very seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability, please do NOT file a public issue on GitHub.

Instead, please send an email to **security@arsalanarshad.dev** (or contact the maintainers directly through private GitHub Security Advisories).

Please include:

- A description of the vulnerability.
- Steps or proof-of-concept to reproduce the issue.
- Potential impact and affected components.

We will acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and work with you to test and release a patch as quickly as possible.
